entities.name: Daretti
entities.description: A goblin Rocketeers team boss who builds their crackling transmitters and drives an all-terrain tank in the race.

entities.name: Redshift
entities.description: A goblin Rocketeer who radios Daretti about a problem.

entities.name: Racket
entities.description: A goblin Rocketeer whose rickety ride is torn apart by a Cloudspire cycler.

entities.name: Far Fortune
entities.description: An Endriders road warrior who faces the Speed Demons and unleashes a blaze.

entities.name: Sita Varma
entities.description: A masked racer for the Aether Rangers who dreams of freedom and is saved by Chandra's fireball.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker racing for Cloudspire who fireballs the Speed Demons.

entities.name: Basri Ket
entities.description: Amonkhet's sand-bending living champion racing with the Champions of Amonkhet.

entities.name: Zahur
entities.description: A leonin leader of the Champions of Amonkhet who has led the vanguard for ages.

entities.name: Khuru
entities.description: A dark-skinned Champion with gold-adorned dreadlocks who dies shielding Zahur and is raised by Amonkheti rites.

entities.name: Winter
entities.description: A racer who commands the Speed Demons, burns with blue flame and keeps a caged creature.

entities.name: Kolodin
entities.description: Cloudspire's captain who urges Chandra to focus.

entities.name: Mendicant Core
entities.description: The captain of the Guidelight Voyagers automatons swallowed in the storm.

entities.name: Kari Zev
entities.description: A captain, accompanied by a monkey, who commentates with Vin and advises the Keelhaulers.

entities.name: Vin
entities.description: A commentator who hosts coverage of the race.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Chandra's mother and the Aether Rangers' mechanic who checks on Khuru.

entities.name: Mohar Varma
entities.description: Sita's father who plots a restoration of the old Consulate with a mind-controlling ally.

entities.name: Harshad
entities.description: An old friend of Mohar who wants to see the new order crushed.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Chandra's partner who gave her a pin.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Someone Chandra thinks might have given a smoldering stare, though he does not seem the type to race.

entities.name: Champions of Amonkhet
entities.description: Amonkheti racers with chariots, lazotep servants and undead.

entities.name: Speed Demons
entities.description: Winter's spectral team with ghoulish glitch ghosts and a demon arm.

entities.name: Rocketeers
entities.description: Goblin racers with explosive rocket cars.

entities.name: Endriders
entities.description: Rugged vagabond racers with whirling chains, chainsaws and flamethrowers.

entities.name: Alacrian Quickbeasts
entities.description: A winged beast team trained for war.

entities.name: Keelhaulers
entities.description: Shark-people racers led by Kari Zev's advice.

entities.name: Guidelight Voyagers
entities.description: Automaton racers captained by Mendicant Core.

entities.name: Team Cloudspire
entities.description: Chandra's racing team.

entities.name: Aether Rangers
entities.description: Avishkar's hometown team that Pia mechanics.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The desert plane through which the second leg of the race passes.

entities.name: Muraganda
entities.description: A lush plane of giant flowers and floating boulders where the racers camp.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: The planar route at the end of the Amonkhet track to Muraganda.

entities.name: Aetherspark
entities.description: The prize at stake for the racers.

entities.name: Ghirapur Grand Prix
entities.description: The multiplanar race the story follows.

events.summary: Rocketeers struggle in the Amonkhet sand as Daretti's goblins are slammed.
events.quote: Daretti's guys are getting absolutely slammed out there.

events.summary: Endriders attack the goblins with flaming chainsaws.
events.quote: Worst of all, a flick of a switch on each of the roaring weapons sets them ablaze.

events.summary: The Speed Demons emerge from the sands in a glitching burst of demonic energy.
events.quote: the glowing, ghoulish explosion of demonic energy that can only be the Speed Demons

events.summary: Far Fortune faces the demon's veil and unleashes the Endriders' blaze.
events.quote: And with that, she unleashes the blaze.

events.summary: Spitfire slices a cannonball in two so that it crashes into Voyager racers.
events.quote: A bladed arc of lightning shoots from the grille to slice the cannonball in two.

events.summary: Spitfire glares at Chandra as she passes her.
events.quote: That's why Spitfire makes a point of glaring back as she passes Avishkar's favorite daughter.

events.summary: A Keelhauler hovership rams Chandra and Cloudspire teammates protect her.
events.quote: A huge, howling hovership rams against the side of Chandra's bike.

events.summary: Chandra touches Nissa's pin to remember the stakes.
events.quote: She touches the pin Nissa gave her.

events.summary: An older Champion dies throwing himself in front of a blow meant for Zahur.
events.quote: Basri watches an older member of the Champions throw himself before a wicked slice meant for Zahur.

events.summary: Basri lifts the fallen charioteer to the lazotep servants on a cloud of sand.
events.quote: On a conjured cloud of sand, he lifts the fallen charioteer.

events.summary: Basri leaps between chariots turning sand into blades to fend off insects.
events.quote: he leaps from one to the other, like stones across a pond, while turning the sand around him into slicing blades

events.summary: Spitfire finds herself in sixth place and renews her resolve for the Aetherspark.
events.quote: Sixth place.

events.summary: Spitfire launches off a god statue's spear to pass the goblins.
events.quote: she launches off the tip of the old god's spear.

events.summary: A fireball blasts away glitch ghosts that were attacking Spitfire, though its heat scorches her.
events.quote: Until a scintillating fireball blasts them away, replacing one threat with another

events.summary: Sita secretly thanks her rescuer in her cockpit.
events.quote: Beneath the mask, in the privacy of her own ride, Sita mutters her thanks.

events.summary: Chandra confronts Winter, who answers that those old enough to race are old enough to die.
events.quote: If they're old enough to race, they're old enough to die.

events.summary: Blue flame engulfs Winter and the demon roars.
events.quote: This time, blue flames sear through Winter's skin.

events.summary: The demon's claw knocks a wheel off the Champions' lead chariot and sends them toward a statue.
events.quote: The claw that would have torn Chandra apart instead knocks a wheel free from the lead chariot.

events.summary: Chandra hurls a fireball that sends the Speed Demons spinning into a dune.
events.quote: Chandra hurls the fireball so hard that only a desperate grab for the handle keeps her from becoming a bright orange smear against the pavement.

events.summary: The caged creature yelps when the fireball hits the Speed Demons, leaving Chandra uneasy.
events.quote: When her fireball hit the Speed Demons, the little guy in the cage yelped.

events.summary: An Omenpath opens at the end of the Amonkhet track, leading to Muraganda.
events.quote: Up ahead, an Omenpath ripples at the end of the track.

events.summary: A huge dust storm swallows the Guidelight Voyagers as the others flee through the Omenpath.
events.quote: In the rearview mirror, Spitfire watches the Guidelight Voyagers, automatons captained by Mendicant Core, as they're swallowed up in the storm.

events.summary: Kari Zev tells Vin that Spitfire knows where to find her if she wants to prove herself.
events.quote: She knows where to find me if she really wants to prove herself

events.summary: Mohar toasts with Harshad to Kaladesh restored, backed by a cloaked mind-controller.
events.quote: Today, we toast to the glorious past of our nation, to Kaladesh restored.

events.summary: The cloaked man boasts he can force minds into any shape.
events.quote: It's as easy for me to force them into the shape I want as it is for you to breathe.

events.summary: Harshad asks to see him crush people's will.
events.quote: I want to see you crush their will, as they have crushed my country.

events.summary: Spitfire is awed by Muraganda's giant flowers and suspended rain.
events.quote: No amount of daydreaming could have prepared her for Muraganda.

events.summary: Spitfire sees Pia talking to the dead Champion who has been raised.
events.quote: Her attention is focused on a member of the Champions: a dark-skinned man with gold-adorned dreadlocks.

events.summary: Pia explains that Khuru is the first raised in the race after giving his life for Zahur.
events.quote: That young man, Khuru, is the first one they've raised during this race.

relations.note: Mother and daughter; Pia checks on Khuru as Chandra's age peer.
Nissa gave her the pin she touches.
relations.quote: She touches the pin Nissa gave her.
Old friend, will you look after the vanguard?
He offered his life for Zahur, and they repaid him with this honor.

relations.note: She calls him out for terrorizing the others.
relations.quote: Pick on somebody your own age, Winter!
Your advice is seeing the Keelhaulers to a solid position

relations.note: Old friends allied in the restoration plan.
relations.quote: You don't need to understand it, old friend.
Daretti's guys are getting absolutely slammed out there.
